title: A Realistic End-to-End Runtime Crossover Estimation for Quantum-Enhanced Training of Large-Scale Machine Learning Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33454v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is one promising application domain for Quantum Computing (QC) speedups, but asymptotic complexity considerations often mask the actual engineering costs of actual end-to-end workflows. For the use case of training a linearized Neural Network with a Quantum Linear Solver, a provably favorable quantum scaling has been suggested. We present realistic resource estimates for this problem, accounting for data access, computation, and readout. Our analysis examines three increasingly complex benchmarking scenarios, under distinct sparsity-scaling assumptions, thereby enabling progressively more realistic resource estimates. We identify crossover regimes relative to classical methods and find that crossover points emerge only for very large problem sizes, long computation times, and highly restrictive output requirements. This work provides a blueprint for evaluating quantum-enhanced ML algorithms under realistic hardwar

translated_title: 面向大规模机器学习模型量子增强训练的端到端运行时间交叉点现实估算
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）是量子计算（QC）加速的一个有前景的应用领域，但渐近复杂度的考量往往掩盖了实际端到端工作流程的真实工程成本。针对使用量子线性求解器训练线性化神经网络的应用场景，已有研究提出了可证明具有优势的量子扩展性。我们针对这一问题提出了现实的资源估算，涵盖了数据访问、计算和读出等环节。我们的分析在三种不同的稀疏性扩展假设下，考察了三个复杂度递增的基准测试场景，从而实现逐步更加贴近现实的资源估算。我们识别了相对于经典方法的交叉区域，并发现交叉点仅在问题规模极大、计算时间很长以及输出要求极为严苛的情况下才会出现。这项工作为在现实硬件条件下评估量子增强的机器学习算法提供了蓝图。
tldr: 该论文对用量子线性求解器训练线性化神经网络进行了涵盖数据访问、计算与读出的端到端现实资源估算，发现量子方法相对于经典方法的优势交叉点仅在问题规模极大、计算时间长且输出要求严苛时才会出现。
en_tdlr: This paper provides realistic end-to-end runtime crossover estimates for quantum-enhanced training of linearized neural networks, finding that quantum advantage over classical methods emerges only for very large problem sizes, long computation times, and highly restrictive output requirements.
